definitions.full: H5682. Abarim עֲבָרִים proper name, of a location 'Abarîm (properly regions beyond river or sea); — usually הָע ׳הַר Num 27:12 ; Deut 32:49 ( = הַלנְֿבוֺ ; both P), and הָע ׳הָרֵי Deuteronomy 33:47 ( נְבוֺ לִפְנֵי ), Deuteronomy 33:48 (P); alone only מֵעֲבָרִים צַעֲקִי Jer 22:20 ; the mountainous district in northwest Moab, just northeast of Dead Sea, GASm Geogr. 548 and EBi Buhl Geogr. 122 ; ᵐ5 Αβαρειμ ( +? ), but τὸ ἐν τῷ πέραν Num 33:47 , εἰς τὸ πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης Jer 22:20 . — See also below עִיִּים .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
“Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
